routes.intent: Prepare an empty, topology-readable workshop location authority.
routes.output_contract: One empty location image preserving topology, fixed facilities, and the spatial anchor.

routes.intent: Animate one serious live-action sequence from approved start and end keyframes.
routes.output_contract: One shot matching approved identity, location, path, action, timing, blur, and sound responsibilities.

prompt_contract.overage_reason: The structured shot must preserve spatial, camera, temporal, finite-exposure, and audio facts.

routes.intent: Prepare picture-linked workshop ambience and contact Foley as separate mix responsibilities.
routes.output_contract: Separate ambience and Foley work orders aligned to the approved shot duration.

routing_rules: Classify the task before choosing a capability family; product photography is not generic image generation.
Treat model names as dated advisories and require a human to inspect the current model schema before manual use.
Bind every reference to one declared role; never fill a reference budget without a production reason.
Keep model-facing prompts short and visible-fact-only; retain QA, rights, continuity, and reconstruction facts in JSON.
For image-to-video, the frame carries appearance while the prompt concentrates on motion, performance, camera, light, physics, and sound.
